run_ddp_il_training: run distributed imitation learning training for Habitat ObjectNav tasks using the DDP trainer
setup_actor_critic_agent: setup the actor-critic policy network and DDPILAgent with optional pretrained weights
configure_short_rollout_threshold: configure the SHORT_ROLLOUT_THRESHOLD to mitigate straggler effects in distributed rollouts
resume_interrupted_training: resume an interrupted DDP training run by loading saved state and optimizer checkpoints
log_training_metrics: log training reward, loss, and episode stats to WandB during distributed training
